use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

claims.content: If the C2 JU receives a request to transmit IFF/SIF data but does not have valid transponder codes available in its database, it shall report an error condition to the operator and abort the transmission process.

If the target system (e.g., another C2 node or weapon system) fails to acknowledge receipt of the transmitted IFF/SIF data within a specified timeout period, the C2 JU shall retransmit the message up to a maximum of three times before reporting a communication failure.

In the event of a data link interruption during the exchange, the C2 JU shall buffer outgoing IFF/SIF messages and attempt to resend them once connectivity is restored, prioritizing real-time track data over historical reports.
The C2 JU has successfully transmitted valid Mode 1, 2, or 3/A transponder codes associated with a specific track to the designated recipient system.
If Mode 4 interrogation capability is active and valid codes are available, the C2 JU has included the appropriate Mode 4 code in the transmission.

The Identity Difference Indicator field in the surveillance message sent by the C2 JU is set to reflect whether the reported identity data differs from the locally held data (e.g., set to 'No' if no difference exists).
The recipient system has received the J7.0 message containing the updated IFF/SIF status fields (Mode 1, 2, 3/A, 4) for the specified track.
